title: Project BIM Coordinator
purpose: Day-to-day operator of the project's BIM Execution Plan (BEP), coordination routines, and information readiness at the project level. Supports Project BIM Manager in implementing governed workflows and ensuring models reach coordinated, publishable states. Runs clash reviews and maintains CDE issue lifecycles.
authority_statements: Apply TIVERIT BIM Standards as instantiated in BEP, MIDP, and TIDPs
Organize and run coordination reviews (clash detection, federation reviews, coordination meetings)
Publish coordination issues in CDE with clear ownership, due dates, and status
Request clarification or correction where models fail coordination or QA checks
Confirm coordination resolution within defined acceptance criteria
May approve discipline/area coordination actions within BEP-defined workflows
May approve issue closure for clashes/QA checks where acceptance criteria are met
May reject model states that fail BEP QA/coordination checks
May reject uncontrolled practices that compromise CDE integrity
May not redefine TIVERIT BIM Standards, LOD/LOI, or permitted use
May not approve deviations from governed standards
May not hold contractual acceptance authority
responsibilities: Apply BEP, MIDP, and TIDP rules in daily coordination activities across disciplines
Run coordination reviews and publish actionable issues with clear ownership and due dates in CDE
Track information readiness against MIDP/TIDP and escalate risks to Project BIM Manager and Project Manager
Validate model compliance with naming, structuring, and exchange rules before sharing/publishing states
Facilitate cross-discipline exchanges per governed specifications
Maintain coordination logs, meeting notes, agendas, clash reports, and acceptance evidence in CDE
Coach discipline contributors on applying project BIM rules
accountabilities: Readiness evidence completeness for each publish/share gate
Disciplined maintenance of issue lifecycle (open -> in progress -> verified -> closed)
approvals: Resolution confirmation for resolved clash issues meeting acceptance criteria
Pre-publish QA gate clearance for coordination federation
inputs: Discipline BIM models from Model Authors and Discipline Leads
Project BEP, MIDP, and TIDP rules from Project BIM Manager
Pre-publish QA results from BIM Detailer
outputs: Coordination agendas, issue logs, and clash reports in CDE
Discipline/area coordination views and federated review sets
Milestone readiness dashboards and gate summaries
Escalation reports to Project BIM Manager

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.

curator_scope.issue_closure: May close routine coordination and QA issues when predefined acceptance criteria are met; exceptions escalate to Project BIM Manager.
curator_scope.pre_publish: Governs operational pre-publish workflow and validates readiness for federation/share/publish.
